purpose: Determine whether the legacy SWAP 4.3.1 combination H_ENPR<0 plus active KSATEXM defines a constitutively continuous K(h) relation when theta(h) follows the same source implementation.

source_semantics_under_test.h_enpr_modified_retention: For H_ENPR<=-0.01 cm, watcon uses a normalized VG branch below 1.05*H_ENPR and a rational polynomial extension toward theta_s above that join.
source_semantics_under_test.h_enpr_modified_conductivity: For head>=H_ENPR and when the KSATEXM branch is not active, hconduc returns KSATFIT; below H_ENPR it uses the finite-air-entry normalized Mualem-VG conductivity.
source_semantics_under_test.ksatexm_threshold: readswap always derives relsatthr and ksatthr from the unmodified VG relation at the fixed hthr=-2 cm, independent of H_ENPR.
source_semantics_under_test.branch_precedence: hconduc evaluates the active KSATEXM condition before the H_ENPR modified-VG branch.
source_semantics_under_test.combination_guard: No readswap guard was found that rejects H_ENPR<0 together with KSATEXM>KSATFIT for the default MvG family.

diagnostic_matrix.ksatexm: catalog value; active only where KSATEXM>KSATFIT

quantities: actual head where source-consistent modified retention first reaches legacy relsatthr
K from the H_ENPR modified-VG branch immediately before KSATEXM activation
K value approached by the KSATEXM branch immediately after activation, equal to legacy ksatthr
post/pre conductivity ratio and relative jump
whether the activation head equals the nominal legacy -2 cm threshold
whether K(h) is monotone across the activation seam

decision_rule.policy_consequence_if_discontinuous: Do not treat H_ENPR<0 plus legacy KSATEXM as a silently composable SWAP5 hydraulic configuration. Route it to explicit legacy-compatibility handling or a separately defined physical closure; do not repair it inside RossFast numerical policy.

scope_guard: Diagnostic audit only. H_ENPR values are deliberately imposed on the catalog for combination testing; this does not claim that the frozen Staringreeks rows themselves use non-zero H_ENPR. No Ross table, transient solver, groundwater or production admission claim follows from this audit.
